name: Flight Radar
description: Hear the aircraft flying near your city: the nearest few on a hotkey, a list of everything in range, optional announcements when one passes overhead or reports an emergency, and a shortcut that opens LiveATC's page for the nearby airport in your browser. Set your city, street address or exact coordinates in Preferences, Flight Radar; your exact location stays on your computer. Aircraft data by adsb.fi and adsb.lol, flight routes by adsbdb.com, address search by OpenStreetMap Nominatim (no account or API key needed).
author: Rafli
